_note: Declarative allowlist of non-pip system dependencies the HEAD runtime is permitted to rely on. Provisioning MUST NOT install anything outside this set, and each entry states its source and why it is trusted. apt packages are pinned to the Raspberry Pi OS (Bookworm) suite; verify installed versions land in the software-manifest at deploy time.

apt_packages.name: python3
apt_packages.reason: System CPython 3.11 interpreter that runs all HEAD scripts.

apt_packages.name: python3-venv
apt_packages.reason: Creates the isolated /opt/manet/venvs/starlink environment for the hashed Starlink stack.

apt_packages.name: python3-serial
apt_packages.reason: pyserial for the Meshtastic collector serial transport (reviewed system stack, README).

apt_packages.name: chrony
apt_packages.reason: Disciplines the system clock; ClockErrorBound QC in starlink_chrony_qc.py reads chronyc.

apt_packages.name: openssh-client
apt_packages.reason: Store-and-forward evidence sync (telemetry_sync_spool.sh) with strict host verification.

apt_packages.name: rsync
apt_packages.reason: Transport for the evidence spool upstream.

apt_packages.name: gzip
apt_packages.reason: Compression for archived evidence produced by scripts/evidence_rotate.py --gzip.

vendored_git.name: starlink-grpc-tools
vendored_git.reason: Provides the starlink_grpc module; not on PyPI, pinned by commit for reproducibility.
